name: Ruskin Park Playground
description: Children's playground in Ruskin Park, with a seasonal paddling pool next to it. The park also has sports pitches, an outdoor gym, toilets and a refreshment kiosk. Open from 7am to 15 minutes before sunset.

nearby.label: No car park; nearby streets are heavily restricted except for Blue Badge holders
